console_comparison: User confirmed real cartridge reaches +127 and PiTrex +60 at approximately the same physical stick position as emulator saturation. No simultaneous voltage or ADC measurement on physical console.
limitations: Only RIGHT live screen value (+126) was explicitly reported; other directions were positioned by user according to live-limit instructions without supplying displayed numeric values.
